svg.title: S05-structured-sequence — source snapshot (not a runtime trace)

g.text: S05-structured-sequence — source snapshot (not a runtime trace)
authenticated actor + service key + audit:write; no client-supplied actor
record truncates occurredAt to MILLIS; requestId maps CHAR(36).
POST time, persisted TIMESTAMP(3), replay and [at,at] query agree.
same content → old id; different content → 400 conflict
failed insert transaction rolled back BEFORE catch re-read
missing existing → rethrow DB exception; existing content rechecked
201 only after commit. Timeout retry uses original requestId; SQL failure is not 201.
